prompt: Can you write acceptance criteria for this? As a team admin, I want to invite people by email so they can join my workspace. An invite expires after 7 days. Only admins can send invites; members see the Invite button disabled. Inviting an email that is already a member shows "This person is already in the workspace." The invite flow should be simple. Bulk invite by CSV is not part of this release.
agent: agy -p in an empty project outside the repository
answer:
## Acceptance criteria: Invite people by email

Requirement: A team admin can invite people by email to join a workspace, with invites expiring after 7 days, sending restricted to admins while members see the Invite button disabled, an error shown when inviting an existing member, and bulk invite by CSV excluded.

### Main path
AC-1. Given a team admin, when the team admin invites a person by email, then an invite is sent to that email. _As a team admin, I want to invite people by email_
AC-2. Given a person invited by email, when the person uses the invite, then the person joins the workspace. _so they can join my workspace._

### Validation and errors
AC-3. Given a team admin, when the team admin invites an email that is already a member, then the message "This person is already in the workspace." is shown. _Inviting an email that is already a member shows "This person is already in the workspace."_

### Permissions and roles
AC-4. Given a user who is not an admin, when the user attempts to send an invite, then the invite is refused. _Only admins can send invites_

### Empty, loading and disabled states
AC-5. Given a member in the workspace, when the member views the Invite button, then the Invite button is disabled. _members see the Invite button disabled._

### Limits
AC-6. Given an invite that was sent more than 7 days ago, when the invited person uses it, then the invite is refused as expired. _An invite expires after 7 days._

### Open questions
- [blocking] Main path: What measurable value defines "simple" for the invite flow? Blocks: "The invite flow should be simple."
- [blocking] Main path: How does an invited person use the email invite to join the workspace? Blocks: AC-2
- [blocking] Permissions and roles: What role is assigned to a person when they join the workspace from an invite? Blocks: AC-2
- [blocking] Limits: What is shown to the invited person when they attempt to use an expired invite? Blocks: AC-6
- [minor] Validation and errors: What happens when a team admin invites an email that already has a pending invite? Validation and errors: What happens when a team admin submits an invalid email address?
- [minor] Main path: What confirmation is shown to the team admin after sending an invite? Limits: How many email addresses can a team admin invite in one action?

### Out of scope
- Bulk invite by CSV. _Bulk invite by CSV is not part of this release._
